claim: The first fiscal quarter of 2025 filing marked a record revenue of $9.0B for Visa.
summary: Visa did report Q1 FY2025 results, but reported net revenue was about $9.6B, not $9.0B, so the $9.0B amount is wrong.

sub_claims.text: Visa had a filing/report for the first fiscal quarter of 2025.
sub_claims.stated_text: The first fiscal quarter of 2025 filing
sub_claims.note: Visa uses a September 30 fiscal year and files quarterly results; Q1 FY2025 corresponds to quarter ended Dec 31, 2024 reported Jan 2025.

sub_claims.text: Visa's revenue in that quarter was $9.0B.
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge Visa Q1 FY2025 net revenue was about $9.6B, not $9.0B; $9.0B materially understates the reported figure.

sub_claims.text: That quarterly revenue was a record all-time high for Visa.
sub_claims.note: Whether this quarter was an all-time record cannot be established from memory alone without complete historical quarterly series and no citations are allowed.
